title: A view of the codegrave timeline
description: One file per view at data/community/<owner>/views/<id>.json. Rules: docs/VIEWS.md. scripts/build.mjs is the authority; this schema is for editor hints.

id.description: Same as the file name. Never changes once merged.

author.description: Optional. If given, it must be the name of the folder the view is in.

category.description: The one branch of the map the view mostly belongs to (a "domains" id in data/categories.json).

labels.description: What the view is about: ids from data/labels.json.

entries.description: Hand-picked entry ids: base entries, or your own. When present the view shows exactly these.

things.description: The older name for "entries". Use one or the other.

checkpoints.description: The chapters: the view's own eras. They must not overlap. Years before the common era are negative; there is no year 0.

image.description: The view's thumbnail: a picture under data/media/ or on Wikimedia Commons, with alt, credit and licence. Without it the build draws a small picture of the view's own lines.

categories.description: Category ids whose things the view holds. Empty means every category.

domains.description: Domain ids from data/categories.json. The view also holds every kind in these domains.
